title: There are no Collatz m-cycles with m ≤ 91
notes: Journal of Integer Sequences 26 (2023) Article 23.3.5. Proves every nontrivial Collatz m-cycle has m≥92, where m is the number of local minima. Valley arrangement carries cycle information beyond (K,L) parity counts; the argument is Diophantine, not spectral. The Juggler run-type count e is the analogous valley count and is already the finance packing parameter. Cited from docs/problems/juggler_cycle_word_functional.md.
